Name: Amruta R Behera
Bio:
Prof Amruta R Behera is an Assistant Professor at Plaksha. Prior to joining Plaksha, Prof Behera worked as a Postdoctoral Researcher at the Centre for Nano Science and Engineering, Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. There, he led a team to develop a pocket-sized near-infrared spectrometer for quality analysis of food and agricultural produce. The team pitched the product idea at Data Innovation Bazaar 2020, a national event organized by Western Digital, and was among the top 10 finalists.

Prof Behera received his BTech in Mechanical Engineering from the National Institute of Technology Warangal and completed his MSc (Engineering) and PhD in Nano Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. After his undergraduate studies, he worked as an engineer at Applied Materials India, where he contributed to the design and fabrication of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

He is also a Certified Instructor at Wolfram Research Inc and contributes as a consultant to the development of mathematics-based educational content.
Education: PhD, IISc Bengaluru | MSc, Nano Science and Engineering, IISc Bengaluru | BTech, Mechanical Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Warangal
Research_Summary:
Prof Behera's PhD research focused on exploration of dynamic characteristics of microelectromechanical systems for potential sensing applications, and development of techniques for measurement of material properties in fabricated micro-mechanical structures.

At Plaksha, he plans to pursue utilitarian research focused on internet-of-things and sensor technologies, to find solutions for the grand challenges in the agriculture and healthcare sector.
